name: prism
description: Prism — an AI screen & code assistant. Chat, debug, and capture your screen on demand. Powered by Featherless AI.

scripts.setup: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install
scripts.build: npm --prefix server install && npm --prefix client install && npm --prefix client run build
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n server,client "npm --prefix server run dev" "npm --prefix client run dev"
